page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, Hebrew roots with Latin glosses and Biblical citations. No marginal notes. Page number top left, running head top centre, signature at the foot.

main_text.p: שנא Chald. Crefcere, Multiplicari, Augeri: Futur. לְמָה יִשְׁנָא Ad quid crefcere? Efrae 4. v.22. שְׁלַמְכוֹן יִסְנָא Pax veftra multiplicetur, Dan.3.v.30. Quaedam exemplaria illic ש habent loco ס. Hinc Hebraice Futurum, יִשְׁנָא Crefcit, Augetur, Job.8.v.7.11. Pih. geminatis literis, Futurum, תְּשַׁנֵּא Facies ut crefcat vel adolefcat, Jefa.17.11. Hiph. Praeterit. הִשְׁנוּ Auxerunt, Pfal.73.12. Particip. מַשְׁנִיא Augens, Job.12.v.23. Futurum, תַּשְׁנִיא Amplificabis, Job.36.v.24.

שְׁנִיא m. Amplus, Job.36.26. Chald. וִיקַר שְׁנִיא Et gloriam multam, Dan.2.6. Plural. מַתְּנֵן רַבְרְבָן שְׁנִיאָן Munera magna & ampla, Dan.2.v.48. Et adverbialiter, שְׁנִיא בְּאֵשׁ Vehementer malum visum fuit, vel displicuit, Dan.6.14. שְׁנִיא מִתְבְּהַל Valde conturbatus fuit, Dan.5.9.

שנב Exaltari, Extolli, Altum, Editum esse: Roborari, Robustum esse: Praeter. שְׁנִבוּ יִשַׁע Extollantur falute, Job.5.11. אֲשֶׁר שְׁנִבָה מִשְׁנוּ Qua robustior nobis fuerit, Deut.2.36. Niph. Praet. וְנִשְׁגַּב Editus, erit, Jef.2.11. Part. נִשְׁגָּב שְׁמוֹ Exaltatum est nomen ejus, Jef.12.4. Pih. Fut. אֲשַׁנְּבֵהוּ Extollam, vel Roborabo eum, Pfal.91.14. Pyh. Fut. יִשְׁנַב In edito collocatur, Prov.29. v.25. Hiph. Futur. יַשְׁנִיב בְּכֹחוֹ Roborat, Extollit virtute fua, Job.36.22.

מִשְׁגָּב m. Locus editus, Munitio, Arx edita: מִשְׁגָּב לָנוּ Locus editus est nobis, Pfal.4.6.8. Conftr. מִשְׁגַּב חוֹמֹתֶיךָ Locum editum murorum tuorum, Jefa.25.12. Aff. מִשְׂגָּבִי Munitio edita mea, Pfal.59.10.
שגב Erravit; Praet. עַל שְׁגָגָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר שָׁגַג Super errore quo erravit, Lev.5.18. Part. שֹׁגֵג אֲנִי Ego errabam, Pfal.119.67. Foem. הַשְּׁגָגָה Qua erravit, Num.15.18.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and the exact placement of some dots are hard to make out at this scan resolution, so the Hebrew forms may differ from the printed ones in vowels and dots; the consonants were copied as seen. The entry headword before "Chald." appears in the left margin area as a large root letter sequence (שנא, שנב, שגב); these are headwords within the text, not marginal notes. The left edge of the scan shows a dark binding shadow with no printed text.
